topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Overview
topics.groupedBecause: This topic provides the opening framing, welcome, and overview of the lecture's focus on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Principles of Innate Recognition: PAMPs, DAMPs, and Self vs. Non-Self
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the molecular criteria and patterns used by the innate immune system to identify infections and tissue damage while distinguishing self from non-self.

topics.label: Pattern Recognition Receptors and Intracellular Signaling Cascades
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the genomic encoding, subcellular distribution, and signaling cascades of pattern recognition receptor systems that translate danger detection into cellular activation.

topics.label: Inflammatory Cascade Propagation, Leukocyte Trafficking, and Systemic Effects
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the propagation of inflammatory responses following sentinel cell activation, including leukocyte recruitment into tissues, lymphatic drainage, and systemic hyperinflammation.

topics.label: Resolution of Inflammation, Tissue Repair, and Chronic Containment
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address the mechanisms responsible for terminating inflammation, repairing damaged tissue, and establishing chronic containment structures when resolution is incomplete.

topics.label: Lecture Closing
topics.groupedBecause: This topic provides the lecture's closing framing and an outlook on the next lecture.
